app.title: Versora
app.subtitle: AI-powered document & file localization with multi-API routing, glossary memory, and 12 UI languages.
app.tagline: Drop a file, a folder or a zip. Get it back translated, in the same shape.
card.lang_fallback: Use English if that language is not available.
sidebar.no_key_hint: No API key configured. UI works; translation will show a clear error.
main.upload: Upload file (txt / md / docx / pdf / json / csv / yaml / po / xliff / xlsx / html / srt / vtt)
main.status_ready: Ready. Upload a file and choose settings.
main.status_no_key: No usable translator. Set an official API key in .env, or install the official Grok / Codex CLI and log in yourself, then retry.
error.no_provider: No translation provider is available. Add at least one API key to .env.
error.extract_failed: Failed to extract text from the file: {detail}
error.empty_file: The file contains no extractable text.
error.provider_unavailable: Selected provider is not configured or its key is missing.
glossary.title: Project glossary (context memory)
glossary.empty: No terms yet. Add domain terms so later translations stay consistent.
sidebar.provider_grok_cli: Official Grok CLI (already logged in on this machine)
sidebar.provider_codex_cli: Official Codex CLI (already logged in on this machine)
sidebar.model_auto: Automatic provider uses that provider’s default model.
sidebar.concurrency_hint: Folder and zip jobs can translate 1–8 files at a time. Default is 2.
sidebar.connect_official_only: Official developer APIs only (OpenAI Platform, Anthropic Console, Gemini API, Groq, DeepSeek, xAI, OpenRouter, Azure OpenAI).
sidebar.save_key_title: Save a key on this computer
sidebar.save_key_ok: Saved. Restart the app if it does not see the key yet.
sidebar.custom_base: Custom HTTPS API address (allowlisted hosts only)
sidebar.oauth_note: Sign-in through chat websites is not available.
main.source_type: What do you want to translate?
main.folder_hint: Type the full folder path. The app looks inside every subfolder.
main.zip_use_zip_mode: Use the zip option for zip files.
main.binary_preview: This file is not plain text.
update.up_to_date: Already on the latest official package.
update.reopen: Update applied. Close this page and run start.bat / start.sh again.
update.failed: Update check failed. Your current files were kept.
card.lang_os: Uses this computer or browser language when possible. English if unknown. You can change it.
keys.local_only: API keys stay in local .env. This screen never shows the full secret.
keys.xai_hint: Optional official xAI developer API key (api.x.ai). This is not a grok.com login and not a subscription.
keys.paste_api: Paste API key (saved in local .env only)
keys.grok_cli_hint: Uses the official grok program already installed and already logged in on this machine. This is not a grok.com website login.
keys.grok_cli_missing: Not found. Install the official Grok CLI yourself from {url}, run grok login in your own terminal, then retry.
keys.grok_cli_login: Found, but not logged in. Run grok login in your own terminal, then retry. This app does not open a browser.
keys.grok_cli_path: Optional path to the official grok program
keys.codex_cli_hint: Uses the official codex program already installed and already logged in on this machine. This is not a ChatGPT website login.
keys.codex_cli_missing: Not found. Install the official Codex CLI yourself from {url}, run codex login in your own terminal, then retry.
keys.codex_cli_login: Found, but not logged in. Run codex login in your own terminal, then retry. This app does not open a browser.
keys.codex_cli_path: Optional path to the official codex program
quick.swap_auto: Pick a source language to swap
quick.where: Source and target languages are on the Translate page.
drop.title: Drop a file here
main.mode_help: Game text: only the words players read. Keys, code and IDs stay as they are.
err.key: The key was refused. Check it in Settings → Keys.
err.rate: The service is busy or out of quota. Try again in a minute.
err.timeout: The service took too long to answer.
err.network: Could not reach the service. Check your connection.
err.empty: No text to translate in this file.
main.no_translator: No translator set up yet. Add an API key in Settings, Keys.
err.generic: Something went wrong with this file.
err.damaged: This {ext} file looks damaged or empty ({size}).
purpose.hint: This editor is the Custom purpose. Presets are picked on the Translate page's quick bar; choose Custom there to use these instructions. Glossary terms still win.
svc.remove_ask: Remove this key from this computer?
svc.install: Not installed. Install it yourself from {url}, sign in from your own terminal, then Re-check.
svc.signin: Not signed in. Run {cmd} in your own terminal, then Re-check. Versora never signs in for you.
svc.unknown: Could not tell whether it is signed in. Test connection to be sure.
svc.blocked: The custom base URL is not on the allowed list, so this API is off.
order.hint: Auto starts at the top. When one fails, refuses or hits its limit, the next one takes over.
order.limits_hint: Both limits hold together; the smaller one wins.
err.spawn: Could not start or reach the translator.
err.signin: The translator program is not signed in. Sign in from your own terminal.
err.truncated: The answer was cut off before the end.
keys.local_plain: Keys are saved in plain text in the local .env file and never leave this computer. Only the last 4 characters are ever shown.
drop.hint: or browse — folder and zip also work
err.damaged_short: This {ext} file looks damaged or empty.
